g.text: card_experiment_01 · apiVersion wyrd/v1 · read-only projection of server truth
Training worker exceeded its 24 GiB memory budget at step 1,412. Provider payloads and
worker internals stay in Observe — this summary is the safe projection.
Series ends at the failure step — retained, never extrapolated.
Reason recorded: superseded by corrected eval configuration (run_06 replaces it).
No execution controls exist in the mock —
lifecycle is visualized, never driven from here.
